Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: Galaxy S27 Ultra
Objective: Global holiday launch spotlighting on-device generative AI nightography and titanium build.
Target Audience: Tech enthusiasts, mobile content creators, and urban professionals aged 25-45.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: Neo QLED 8K Vision TV
Objective: Introduce cutting-edge neural quantum 8K processor and ultra-slim infinity screen for premium home theater.
Target Audience: Cinephiles, sports enthusiasts, and luxury homeowners seeking immersive audio-visuals.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: Bespoke AI Laundry Combo
Objective: All-in-one washer and heat-pump dryer with energy-saving AI Wash and customizable color panels.
Target Audience: Busy dual-income families and eco-conscious modern apartment dwellers aged 30-50.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: NovaBuds Pro 3 Wireless
Objective: Back-to-campus push for high-res lossless audio, active noise cancellation, and seamless ecosystem switching.
Target Audience: Gen Z college students, daily commuters, and fitness enthusiasts aged 18-29.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: Odyssey Ark G9 OLED Gaming Monitor
Objective: Drive adoption of 49-inch dual QHD 240Hz curved OLED monitor for competitive esports and remote developer workflows.
Target Audience: Hardcore PC gamers, simulation racers, and software engineers aged 22-40.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: Galaxy Book5 Ultra
Objective: Urgent 48-hour Cyber Weekend flash promotion with aggressive trade-in incentives and limited inventory countdown.
Target Audience: Bargain hunters and tech upgraders seeking laptop performance upgrades.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: Nova Smart Soundbar S60
Objective: Hyper-local community pop-up studio test targeting urban neighborhood cafes with micro spend.
Target Audience: Local neighborhood music lovers and cafe patrons in downtown Seoul.

Brand: Nova Electronics Corp
Product: 갤럭시 S27 울트라
Objective: 국내 프리미엄 스마트폰 교체 수요를 겨냥한 온디바이스 AI 야간 사진 프로모션.
Target Audience: 모바일 사진과 브이로그를 즐기는 2030 크리에이터 및 직장인.
